correctness.rationale: For any integer P,Q and positive s, companion C=(P,−Q;1,0) gives U_j=(C^j)_{21}. At good p∤Δ, separability over F_{p²} gives C^{p^{2s}}≡C mod p, and commuting-binomial lifting yields successive p^r local differences mod p^r. At bad p|Δ, including p=2, C≡αI+N, N²=0; p^{2s} powers collapse to αI mod p, so for r≥2 differences are divisible by p^{r−1}, requiring only one factor p in M. These local congruences yield Dold n-divisibility by Möbius pairing over each p^r||n. At n=p, U_{p^{2s}}−U_1≡−1 mod p forces every p|Δ to divide M; if Δ=0 all primes force divisibility, impossible. Independently checked 10,998 finite exact Möbius congruences for P∈[−4,4], Q∈[−5,5], s=1,2,3, n≤39, plus Δ=0 prime obstructions; these are corroborative, not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: Sharp necessary-and-sufficient Dold multipliers of nonlinearly indexed Lucas sequences are natural arithmetic invariants. The radical(|Δ|) classification is strictly stronger than previously sufficient |Δ| scaling for discriminants with square factors, handles every even power and all signed integer recurrence parameters, and proves nonexistence at Δ=0. This distinguishes Dold divisibility from unrealized nonnegative orbit counts.
